title: A Delicious Day
content:
Emma loves food. For her, every meal is a special moment.

In the morning, she has **breakfast** at a small café. She orders **bread**, **eggs**, and **fruit**. To drink, she has a cup of **coffee** and a glass of **orange juice**.

At noon, Emma meets her friend Leo for **lunch**. They go to an Italian restaurant.

Leo orders **pasta** with **chicken**, while Emma chooses a fresh **salad**. They also share a bottle of **water**.

“This is delicious!” Leo says.

In the afternoon, they stop at a bakery for a snack. Emma eats a piece of **cake**, and Leo buys a **sandwich**. They both drink **tea**.

Later that evening, Emma prepares **dinner** at home. She cooks **rice**, **vegetables**, and **fish**.

For **dessert**, she enjoys some **ice cream**.

At the end of the day, Emma smiles.

“Good food, good drinks, and good company,” she says. “What more do I need?”
